title: Rabbi Zeira bar Zevid
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Seder HaDorot says, “I did not find him.” Otzar Yisrael then gives Berakhot 38a as his source, but Hyman says it misunderstood the plain sense of the Gemara: the rabbis praised the son of Rav Zevid, brother of Rabbi Shmuel bar Rav Zevid, to Rabbi Zeira, saying that the son of Rav Zevid was a great man. Hyman regards this as clear.

notes.text: The unnamed son of Rav Zevid is praised to Rabbi Zeira; the passage does not call him Zeira bar Zevid. The complete primary paragraph names his brother Shmuel. Hyman’s initials ר״ש were mistranslated as Shimon in the earlier draft.
